terms.comment: The botanists’ name, from Spanish vainilla, little pod. Not in Lewis & Short.

phrases.latin: Gelātum ē vanillā vīs an ē socolātā?
phrases.english: Do you want vanilla ice cream or chocolate?

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. vanilla; s.v. ice cream, for glaciēs ē socolātā (vanillā, frāgīs). Traupman and Levi–Bini have no word.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
